title: Is there a human trial of dimercaprol for chronic lead, arsenic, or mercury exposure?

grade.title: No qualifying human study in this corpus
grade.outcome: Chronic lead, arsenic, or mercury exposure
grade.basis: No qualifying human study was located in the recorded search.

answerHtml: The corpus records a PubMed search on 14 October 2026 for trials or randomized studies of dimercaprol in lead, arsenic, or mercury that returned no records. Dimercaprol is not graded. Historical use in acute poisoning is not documented in the saved sources for this site, so it is not described here.

sections.heading: What this does not mean
sections.html: Not graded means the search did not locate a qualifying study. It is not a statement that the drug has no effect in acute poisoning.
